source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role operator) or action export; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except operator; a trusted delete prefers review at priority 80. Action inspect in context external prefers deny at priority 70. Role guest and context partner prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role operator) or action export; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means context sandbox with any role except operator; a trusted delete prefers review at priority 80.
Action inspect in context external prefers deny at priority 70.
Role guest and context partner prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == operator)) or (event.action == export)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role != operator)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then abstain

rule TrustedDelete:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == delete)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule InspectExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule GuestPartner:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.role != analyst)
    then prefer label = review priority 1
